I want to note that figure as written appears to be inaccurate as a statement of fact — PepsiCo's quarterly revenue is consistently reported in the billions (around $18-19 billion in Q1 in recent years), not millions, so an official filing would almost certainly show $19.4 *billion* if that number appears. You should check the official Q1 2026 SEC 10-Q filing directly to confirm the correct unit before sharing as a headline.
